artworks.title: Head of a Siren
artworks.medium: black chalk with white heightening on brown laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a sketched portrait of a person. The figure is turned slightly to the viewer's right, showcasing a three-quarter view of the face. The portrait features delicate facial features, smooth complexion, full lips, and bright eyes looking to the right. The person has long, wavy hair cascading around their shoulders. The clothing is loosely sketched, suggesting soft fabric. The background is plain with a subtle texture. An inscription in the upper left corner reads "1609."

artworks.title: Reclining Nude
artworks.medium: lithograph on cardboard
artworks.description: The image depicts a sketched art piece of a human figure reclining on a surface in a fetal-like position. The figure is lying on their side with one arm under their head and the other arm across their torso. The facial features are soft and slightly abstract, and the hair is drawn with wavy lines blending into the background pattern. The individual in the image is not wearing clothing. The surface beneath them has bold, wavy lines resembling fabric or bedding. The background is a high-contrast abstract design with dark, irregular patterns surrounding the figure.

artworks.title: Dancing Couple (Tanzpaar)
artworks.medium: lithograph on yellow wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows flowing black lines and shapes against a vibrant yellow background. The lines and forms suggest human figures entwined or interacting, with one prominent figure having a discernible face. The curves and contours resemble intertwined limbs and abstract shapes that may represent draped fabrics or organic forms. The elements in the visual evoke movement and fluidity, akin to a dynamic dance captured in an abstract style.

artworks.title: Naked Girls in the Studio (Nackte Mädchen im Atelier)
artworks.medium: lithograph on wove paper
artworks.description: This print depicts two nude women. One woman in the center of the print is standing, her body facing us, her head turned to the left. One of her knees is slightly bent, and her hands are together, holding a cloth. She has dark, thick hair styled up into a bun, and simple facial features created with angular lines: thin eyebrows, a straight nose, and a round, closed mouth. The other woman is seated on the left of the print, facing left, leaning forward and raising a cigarette to her mouth with one hand. Her dark hair is styled up around her head, and she appears to be wearing an earring. The background is minimalistic, with abstract shapes and lines, including a bucket-shaped object between the women. The print uses bold, black lines on a light, off-white background.

artworks.title: Russian Dancers
artworks.medium: color lithograph on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals. On the left, there is a person sitting, with their body shown from the upper thighs to the head. This person has their hair swept back away from the face, and is draped in a white garment. The facial features are simple. To the right, there is another person standing and facing the seated individual, shown from the upper body to the lower legs. This standing figure has short, dark hair and is wearing a bright yellow shirt with long sleeves and light blue pants. They appear to be holding a white cloth near the seated person's head. The background is composed of abstract patterns using colors like dark blue, red, and white. The overall style is loose and painterly, with bold use of color and simplified forms.

artworks.title: Three Bathers by Stones
artworks.medium: color lithograph in pink, blue, red, and black on calendered paper
artworks.description: This painting features abstract figures against a blue background. Three figures in bold pink lines are depicted near a blue area. The contrast between the figures and the blue background creates a dynamic composition. The use of color and brushstrokes conveys motion and spontaneity. The forms are simplified, emphasizing abstraction.

artworks.title: Saint John at the Foot of the Cross
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and brown wash on laid paper; laid down
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Baer
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length sketch of a person standing and facing slightly to the side. The person is depicted in a three-quarter view from the back, directing their gaze upward to the left. They have short, wavy hair that is neatly combed back. The clothing consists of flowing, draped garments, typical of classical attire, with visible folds and lines adding depth to the fabric's texture. There is no visible jewelry or object being held by the person. The background consists of an empty space, and the entire image is bordered by a series of rectangular frames that accentuate the central sketch. The frames vary in thickness and are layered to give the appearance of depth.

artworks.title: Road along a Winding River
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink, squared in black chalk, on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Baer
artworks.description: The image is a landscape sketch depicting a view from an elevated point. The horizon is positioned at the vertical center, with undulating lines suggesting distant hills or tree lines. There is a horizontal axis across the center, adding depth to the landscape. The sketch features expressive brushstrokes, swirling lines representing foliage and water movement. The color palette is monotone, using sepia tones for an antique look. The foreground has curved lines indicating flowing water or terrain, while detailed strokes suggest vegetation and rocky outcrops in the distance. The grid overlay serves as a structured backdrop, indicating the drawing may be a study.

artworks.title: The Entombment
artworks.medium: engraving in brown ink on laid paper; laid down
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to and within plate mark): 29.9 x 44.2 cm (11 3/4 x 17 3/8 in.)

artworks.title: The Baptism of Christ, Set in a Mountainous Landscape
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 32.2 x 45.5 cm (12 11/16 x 17 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape viewed from above, featuring distant hills, a cloudy sky, and a castle-like structure surrounded by trees. There is a river scene with figures near the foreground, one holding a staff. The artwork is monochromatic with various shades of gray, resembling an engraving. Tall trees near the river add depth to the composition, leading the eye towards the central structure and distant mountains.

artworks.title: Juno
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 21.5 x 16.7 cm (8 7/16 x 6 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated from the side, leaning on her left elbow on a ledge. Her right hand is on top of her left arm. Her head is slightly tilted to the left with a gentle expression, soft facial features, and wavy hair styled back with a headdress. She wears a gown with puffed sleeves and draping. In the background, there is a sculpted surface with a garland on the left and a peacock behind her on the right. The peacock's plume adds detail to the composition. The overall tone of the image is earthy and warm.

artworks.title: The Madonna and Child Enthroned, with Saints Corbinian and Sigismund
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red lake, red-orange, green, blue, and yellow on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays a seated woman holding a child on her lap. The woman has long, wavy hair and wears an ornate crown and flowing robe with intricate patterns. The child is seated naked on her lap. On the left of the woman stands a figure wearing a mitre and long robes holding a staff. On the right, another figure wearing a crown and robe holds an orb and a scepter. The background features a throne-like seating area and a checkered green and black floor with various objects nearby. Ornate patterns frame the scene.

artworks.title: The Ruins of Netley Abbey
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper [1st state]
artworks.description: The image depicts an elevated view of ruins of an arched gothic structure surrounded by dense foliage. The horizon is hidden by tall trees surrounding the ruins. The drawing style features intricate brushstrokes and cross-hatching creating texture in the leaves and stonework. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of brown and sepia. Closest to us, there is textured ground leading up to the structure, while the trees and ruins in the background appear less detailed as they recede.

artworks.title: Milford Bridge
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper [1st state]
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with trees, foliage, a horizon in the background, and birds in flight. The brushstrokes are intricate and detailed with swirling lines typical of etching. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of black and tan. A dirt path curves between the trees.

artworks.title: Little Girl with a Large Hat
artworks.medium: gouache over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image features the upper body of a figure, depicted from the waist up. The figure is angled slightly towards the right. The facial features are basic lines indicating the eyes and mouth. The figure has long, light-colored hair flowing from underneath a wide-brimmed hat. They are wearing a loose, long-sleeved outfit. In the background, there is a soft, muted brownish-purple color. A signature is visible in the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Shepherd with Goats (Les chèvres)
artworks.medium: etching from two plates on two sheets of laid paper; attached
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (l. + rt. Pl. combined): 20.3 x 26.3 cm (8 x 10 3/8 in.)
overall (l. + rt. Sh. combined): 20.7 x 26.7 cm (8 1/8 x 10 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral landscape with grazing goats on a slope under sprawling trees. The horizon is high in the composition, featuring rolling hills and distant buildings. The etching technique creates a monochromatic palette, emphasizing light and shadow. The background depicts a vast sky with silhouettes of birds in flight.

artworks.title: Lady and Gentlemen Riding in a Park
artworks.medium: brush and brown ink with touches of pen and brown ink over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of horse riders in a forest. The scene depicts three individuals on horseback, traversing through a wooded area. Each rider is clad in formal, historical attire with wide-brimmed hats. The central focus is a woman adorned with a decorative hat and a flowing outfit. She is accompanied by a rider on either side, each on their own horse. The background features a dense forest with tall, twisted trees and abundant foliage. The use of monochromatic tones gives the drawing a timeless, classical atmosphere.

artworks.title: A Capriccio View of Roman Ruins along the Tiber
artworks.medium: pen and brush and iron gall ink on laid paper; laid down
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with architectural ruins, likely of classical origin, visible from an elevated point of view. The horizon is positioned higher in the frame, revealing distant buildings and a faint mountainous outline against the sky. Close to us, figures and animals traverse a path leading up to a large structure reminiscent of an ancient Roman triumphal arch on the right side. The brushstrokes in the image are loose and fluid. The color palette consists of sepia tones, highlighted with shades of brown and beige.

artworks.title: The Angel Appearing to Hagar and Ishmael
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and brown wash over black and red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures. One has wings and the other is reclining with an infant. The scene is rendered in a loose, sketchy style with a monochrome color palette of browns using ink wash over pencil or pen lines. The winged figure on the left stands with an outstretched arm, appearing to interact with the reclining figure on the right. The reclining figure holds an infant and looks upwards. The background features minimal detail, suggesting a natural setting with trees and clouds. The drawing conveys movement and interaction between the characters, reminiscent of classical or mythological themes.

artworks.title: A Boy Smiling
artworks.medium: black chalk
artworks.description: The image depicts a charcoal drawing of a person's head and shoulders in a three-quarter view. The person is slightly turned to their left, showing their face in profile while displaying both eyes. They have soft facial features and wavy hair framing the face, with a curl at the front. The head is adorned with what seems to be a cap or headband. The person wears a garment with a broad, textured collar. The background is obscured by crosshatched shading, creating a textured backdrop.

artworks.title: An Italianate Garden with a Parrot, a Poodle, and a Man
artworks.medium: watercolor and pen and brown ink over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Anne Eustis Emmet in memory of David E. Finley
artworks.description: The image depicts a view through a stone frame into an ornate garden scene. Two large columns stand on either side, with detailed urns atop pedestals beside each column. A red parrot perches on the urn to the right. A figure reclines on the stone ledge, gazing towards the garden. The garden features an elaborate fountain with sculpted figures and water jets. Lush green trees provide a backdrop, with a majestic building to the left. The color palette includes earthy browns, deep greens, sky blues, red, and purple tones.

artworks.title: Four Ladies with Fancy Hats
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Frank Eyerly, Mr. and Mrs. Arthur G. Altschul, Malcolm Wiener, and the Samuel H. Kress Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows an array of shapes and lines in an abstract scene. In the foreground, there are dark angular shapes resembling hat silhouettes with faintly sketched faces. The background consists of a pattern of scattered green brushstrokes on a light backdrop. A rich blue border at the top hints at a sky or horizon. The composition blends familiar objects like hats, leaves, and faces with an abstract quality.

artworks.title: The Emperor Ferdinand II
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a portrait depicting a man. The man is shown facing forward with a mustache and wavy hair. He wears regal clothing with fine patterns and a decorative collar. An ornate oval frame surrounds the portrait with swirls and lion figures. In the background are detailed scrollwork and decorative designs, along with Latin text inside and outside the frame.

artworks.title: Il Tedeschino
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 35.9 x 25.3 cm (14 1/8 x 9 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated on a horse in a side-saddle position, holding a flag that is unfurling in the air. The person has a mustache and is wearing a hat, a patterned garment covering the body, and their feet in stirrups. A sword hilt is visible at their side. To the left, a cherubic figure with curly hair is holding a shield with a crown. The background features architectural elements, domes, and a cityscape under a sky with thin cloud formations.
